parameters.name: MAVEN_PROFILE_NAME
parameters.description: Profile to use in mvn command to run the tests. Possible values are wls-srg (the default), integration-tests, toolkits-srg, kind-sequential and kind-upgrade. Refer to weblogic-kubernetes-operator/integration-tests/pom.xml on the branch.

parameters.name: IT_TEST
parameters.description: Comma separated list of individual It test classes to be run e.g., ItParameterizedDomain, ItMiiUpdateDomainConfig, ItMiiDynamicUpdate*, ItMiiMultiMode

parameters.name: OPERATOR_LOG_LEVEL
parameters.description: The default log level is not set

parameters.name: KIND_VERSION
parameters.description: Kind version.

parameters.name: HELM_VERSION
parameters.description: Helm version

parameters.name: ISTIO_VERSION
parameters.description: Istio version

parameters.name: PARALLEL_RUN
parameters.description: Runs tests in parallel. Default is true, test classes run in parallel.

parameters.name: NUMBER_OF_THREADS
parameters.description: Number of threads to run the classes in parallel, default is 3.

parameters.name: WDT_DOWNLOAD_URL
parameters.description: URL to download WDT.

parameters.name: WIT_DOWNLOAD_URL
parameters.description: URL to download WIT.

parameters.name: REMOTECONSOLE_VERSION
parameters.description: RemoteConsole version.

parameters.name: BASE_IMAGES_REPO
parameters.description: Repository to pull the base images. Make sure to modify the image names if you are modifying this parameter value.

parameters.name: WEBLOGIC_IMAGE_NAME
parameters.description: WebLogic base image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/weblogic for OCR.

parameters.name: WEBLOGIC_IMAGE_TAG
parameters.description: 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk17-ol8, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk17-ol9, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk21-ol8, 14.1.2.0-generic-jdk21-ol9, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol7, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol8, 12.2.1.4-generic-jdk8-ol9, 12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7,12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7, 12.2.1.4-slim-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol8, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk8-ol9, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk11-ol8, 14.1.1.0-generic-jdk11-ol9, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk11-ol7, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk11-ol8, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk8-ol7, 14.1.1.0-slim-jdk8-ol8

parameters.name: FMWINFRA_IMAGE_NAME
parameters.description: FWM Infra image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO. Use middleware/fmw-infrastructure for OCR.

parameters.name: DB_IMAGE_NAME
parameters.description: Oracle DB image name. Default is the image name in BASE_IMAGES_REPO, use database/enterprise for OCR.

parameters.name: DB_IMAGE_TAG
parameters.description: Oracle DB image tag

parameters.name: COLLECT_LOGS_ON_SUCCESS
parameters.description: Collect logs for successful runs. Default is false.

body.name: sh
args:
export PATH="${WORKSPACE}/bin:${PATH}"
                                    export KUBECONFIG=${kubeconfig_file}
                                    export BASE_IMAGES_REPO_USERNAME="${OCIR_USER}"
                                    export BASE_IMAGES_REPO_PASSWORD="${OCIR_PASS}"
                                    export BASE_IMAGES_REPO_EMAIL="noreply@oracle.com"
                                    export TEST_IMAGES_REPO_USERNAME="${OCIR_USER}"
                                    export TEST_IMAGES_REPO_PASSWORD="${OCIR_PASS}"
                                    export TEST_IMAGES_REPO_EMAIL="noreply@oracle.com"
                                    mkdir -p integration-tests/target/failsafe-reports "${result_root}/diagnostics/ItLocalTwin" "${result_root}/workdir/liftandshiftworkdir"  # j2gha-local: the directories the stage post archives from
                                    printf '%s\n' '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' '<testsuite name="ItLocalTwin" tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0" time="0.2">' '  <testcase name="testOperatorBuilds" classname="ItLocalTwin" time="0.1"/>' '  <testcase name="testHelmChart" classname="ItLocalTwin" time="0.1"/>' '</testsuite>' > integration-tests/target/failsafe-reports/TEST-ItLocalTwin.xml  # j2gha-local: a failsafe report in place of the integration tests (junit + archive read it)
                                    echo "operator diagnostics for profile ${MAVEN_PROFILE_NAME}" > "${result_root}/diagnostics/ItLocalTwin/operator.log"  # j2gha-local: a diagnostics file for the stage post archive
                                    echo "lift-and-shift work directory" > "${result_root}/workdir/liftandshiftworkdir/README.txt"  # j2gha-local: a liftandshift file for the stage post archive
                                    if ! echo mvn -pl integration-tests -P ${MAVEN_PROFILE_NAME} verify 2>&1 | tee "${result_root}/kindtest.log"; then  # j2gha-local: was `time mvn ... verify` (the Kubernetes integration tests, hours); dash has no `time`
                                        echo "integration-tests failed"
                                        exit 1
                                    fi

always.name: sh
args:
export PATH="${WORKSPACE}/bin:${PATH}"
                                export KUBECONFIG=${kubeconfig_file}
                                mkdir -m777 -p ${result_root}/kubelogs
                                if ! kind export logs "${result_root}/kubelogs" --name "${kind_name}" --verbosity 99; then
                                    echo "Failed to export kind logs for kind cluster ${kind_name}"
                                fi
                                if ! podman exec kind-worker journalctl --utc --dmesg --system > "${result_root}/journalctl-kind-worker.out"; then
                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for kind worker"
                                fi
                                if ! podman exec kind-control-plane journalctl --utc --dmesg --system > "${result_root}/journalctl-kind-control-plane.out"; then
                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for kind control plane"
                                fi
                                if ! journalctl --utc --dmesg --system --since "$start_time" > "${result_root}/journalctl-compute.out"; then
                                    echo "Failed to run journalctl for compute node"
                                fi

                                mkdir -m777 -p "${WORKSPACE}/logdir/${BUILD_TAG}/wl_k8s_test_results"
                                mv -f ${result_root}/* "${WORKSPACE}/logdir/${BUILD_TAG}/wl_k8s_test_results"  # j2gha-local: no sudo in the harness (the files are the build user's own)
